name: Dimitrios Papas
bio:
Dimitrios comes to motorsport from a diverse background in public administration, where he spent nearly thirty years navigating complex organizational structures. His passion for racing was ignited during a family trip to the Acropolis Rally as a child, a memory that fueled a lifelong fascination with the sport. Now, eager to contribute his extensive administrative experience, he aims to streamline HR processes within a racing team, fostering a supportive and efficient work environment. 

Dimitrios believes in a people-first approach, prioritizing employee well-being and professional development. He is known for his meticulous attention to detail and his ability to identify and resolve potential conflicts before they escalate. His goal is to build a strong, cohesive team that is fully engaged and motivated to achieve collective success, bringing a fresh perspective to the HR department.

What makes Dimitrios distinct is his experience outside of motorsport, giving him an atypical approach to the job.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave on top
physical.description: Dimitrios is a man of average height with a sturdy build, reflecting his active lifestyle.

quirks: Always carries a small worry stone in his pocket and rubs it during meetings.
Insists on starting every Monday with a team coffee break to discuss non-work related topics.
Keeps a detailed logbook of employee birthdays and work anniversaries, sending personalized notes.
